copy.en:

The foldable holder keeps your phone positioned while the two-zone interior organizes travel essentials.
TSA combination lock supports faster customs inspection
Wet-dry pocket, mesh zip pocket, and X-shaped straps

design_brief_zh: 主卖点为拉杆上的可折叠手机支架，画面同时用行李箱内部结构证明收纳价值，并以TSA密码锁作为第二个可信细节。PC端采用左文右产品：左侧文案区按标题、支持说明、证据细节1、证据细节2自上而下排列，区域为画布[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.10,0.38,0.80]；右侧产品区为[0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84]。主产品呈45度左右的半开箱角度，箱体外观、竖条纹、铝合金边框、颜色和比例须与实物一致；箱盖打开，清晰展示双区内衬，一侧展示干湿分离袋与网格拉链袋，另一侧展示X型固定带固定衣物。拉杆完全伸出并打开手机支架，支架上可放置一部手机但不显示任何品牌或可读界面；TSA密码锁在前景以适度近景呈现。移动端重新排版为上方产品与使用场景、底部文案：产品区[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，文案区[0.05,0.64,0.90,0.31]，阅读顺序仍为标题→支持说明→TSA细节→内部收纳细节。使用欧洲现代旅行摄影风格、低饱和中性色和自然侧光，突出箱体材质、内衬分区和支架结构；避免过度反光、夸张透视和拥挤道具。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题加粗，正文和细节短句分层，德语预留约20%的横向扩展空间。每行文案分别对应：标题强调手机支架；支持说明连接支架使用与双区内衬；证据/细节1展示TSA密码锁及快速查验用途；证据/细节2对应干湿分离袋、网格拉链袋和X型固定带。所选卖点均有产品资料支持，无需补充缺失规格。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的产品事实：可折叠手机支架、TSA密码锁、双区内衬、干湿分离袋、网格拉链袋和X型固定带。不得宣称防盗、绝对安全、静音、通过特定航空公司尺寸认证或任何未提供的测试、认证和官方背书；“更快查验”仅表述为便于海关进行快速行李查验。图片不得出现竞品商标、虚构界面、评分、促销标签或无法验证的性能对比。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European modern travel product photograph for a YWJ 13A hard-shell travel suitcase, matching the supplied physical product appearance, color, proportions, vertical shell texture, polycarbonate/ABS shell, and aluminum frame. Show the suitcase partially open at a natural three-quarter angle on the right side of the composition, with the telescopic handle extended and its foldable phone holder visibly opened; place a generic smartphone on the holder with a blank, non-readable screen and no logos. Open the case wide enough to clearly prove the two-zone polyester interior: one side has a wet-dry separation pocket and a mesh zip pocket, the other side has X-shaped garment straps holding clothing. Include a clear but secondary close view of the TSA combination lock. Use restrained travel props only, such as neatly folded clothing and a small toiletry item, avoiding clutter. PC layout: leave a clean text-safe area on the left 38% of a 2000x2000 square canvas and place the product in the right 46%; mobile layout: place the product and lifestyle scene in the upper 53% of a 1200x1200 square canvas and reserve the lower 31% for copy. Use soft natural side lighting, low-saturation neutral European travel photography, controlled reflections, crisp material detail, and a refined premium mood. Do not render any text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, badges, watermarks, or readable smartphone content anywhere in the image.
